supplements.title: Applying Lifestyle Medicine to Enhance Cancer Survivorship and Patient Well-being.
supplements.summary: Lifestyle medicine—including exercise, nutrition, sleep, stress management, and social connection—improves cancer survivorship and patient outcomes.

supplements.title: ZIF-8/polydopamine nanocomposite functionalized with hyaluronic acid and folic acid for pH-responsive resveratrol delivery and apoptosis induction in colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: A nanoparticle delivery system successfully released resveratrol into colorectal cancer cells, triggering apoptosis and reducing cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Targeting Pyruvate Kinase M2: Signal Transduction Pathways and Exploration of Cancer Therapeutic Strategies.
supplements.summary: Blocking pyruvate kinase M2 shows promise as a cancer treatment by disrupting key tumor-promoting pathways, though clinical application remains challenging.

supplements.title: Cross-kingdom signals: microbial, metabolites, and immune cells on the gut-breast axis.
supplements.summary: Gut microbes and their metabolites influence breast cancer progression and lactation health through the gut-breast axis.

supplements.title: Effect of Fermented Papaya Preparation Intake on Fatigue Recovery, Useful Field of View and Oxidative Stress: A Pilot Interventional Study in Professional Bus and Motor Racing Drivers.
supplements.summary: Fermented papaya supplement reduced fatigue and improved focus in professional drivers through antioxidant effects.

supplements.title: Nobiletin attenuates self-renewal in cervical cancer cells and spheres through miR-342-3p upregulation and FOXM1 downregulation.
supplements.summary: Nobiletin, a citrus compound, reduces cervical cancer cell self-renewal by increasing miR-342-3p and decreasing FOXM1 levels.

supplements.title: Baicalein Sensitizes Radioresistant BT549 and MCF7-R Breast Cancer Cells by Modulating Rac1 Signaling.
supplements.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, makes radioresistant breast cancer cells more sensitive to radiation by blocking Rac1 protein activity.

supplements.title: Teprenone conjugated with a planar catechin analog enhances cytotoxicity against cancer cells.
supplements.summary: A new compound combining planar catechin and teprenone shows enhanced cancer cell-killing ability compared to catechin alone.

supplements.title: In vitro, in vivo, and anticytotoxic effects of silver nanoparticles green synthesized by Astragalus baba-alliar against Giardia lamblia infection.
supplements.summary: Silver nanoparticles synthesized from plant extract effectively killed Giardia parasites in lab and animal tests, offering a safer alternative to standard medications.

supplements.title: Optimizing Intervention Tools to Improve Nutrition and Physical Activity for Cancer Survivors (Tools To Be Fit)
supplements.summary: Study tests four intervention tools to help cancer survivors improve nutrition, physical activity, and weight after treatment completion.

supplements.title: Southern European Prospective Investigation Into Childhood Cancer and Nutrition (EPICkids)
supplements.summary: EPICkids tracks nutrition, lifestyle, and quality of life in Southern European children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia and brain tumors to improve treatment outcomes.

supplements.title: Protective Role of Apigenin-PEGylated Chitosan Nanoparticles Against Pesticide Deltamethrin-Induced Liver Injury via Antioxidant Activation, NF-κB Inhibition, and Bcl-2/Bax/Caspase-3 Signaling Modulation.
supplements.summary: Apigenin-loaded nanoparticles effectively protect rat livers from pesticide damage by boosting antioxidants and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Exploring the potential targets and mechanisms of artemisinin in the treatment of diabetic kidney disease using network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin may treat diabetic kidney disease by restoring the FLT1 protein, which protects kidney cells from high-glucose damage.

supplements.title: A bioactive pigment from violet-hued bacteria: a dual approach against prostate cancer and bacterial infections.
supplements.summary: A purple pigment from soil bacteria kills prostate cancer cells and fights bacterial infections effectively.

supplements.title: Individual Short-Chain Fatty Acids Differentially Reprogram Transcriptional States in Colorectal Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Different short-chain fatty acids from gut bacteria alter gene expression patterns differently in colorectal cancer cells.

off_label.title: Targeting USP10/SCD1 axis by RAF265 suppresses lipogenesis and induced ferroptosis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: RAF265 suppresses head and neck cancer growth by blocking USP10, reducing fat production and triggering cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Investigating the Efficacy of Propranolol in Treating Chronic Stress Combined with Colorectal Cancer in Mice and Its Antitumor Potential.
off_label.summary: Propranolol, a blood pressure medication, reduced colorectal cancer tumor growth in stressed mice, offering a potential treatment for cancer patients with depression.

off_label.title: Combinatorial drug repurposing of Valproic acid and Zebularine regulates Krüppel-like factor 4 and β-catenin expression in colon cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Combining two repurposed drugs effectively inhibits colon cancer cell growth by altering key cancer-related gene expression.

off_label.title: Novel Long-Acting Ghrelin Analogue PEP-064 Restores Energy Balance in C26 and Lewis Lung Carcinoma-Induced cachexia in Mice.
off_label.summary: A new long-acting ghrelin drug called PEP-064 successfully restores weight and energy balance in mice with cancer cachexia.

off_label.title: Alogliptin-metformin synergy ameliorates diabetes-associated bone loss via modulation of DPP-4 activity and OPG/RANKL signaling.
off_label.summary: Combined alogliptin-metformin treatment protects bones in diabetic rats by reducing inflammation and restoring bone-regulating protein balance.

off_label.title: Fuzuloparib enhances radiosensitivity of gain-of-function mutant p53 R273H NSCLC by promoting SLC7A11/GSH/GPX4 axis mediated ferroptosis.
off_label.summary: Fuzuloparib enhances radiation therapy effectiveness in mutant p53 lung cancer by triggering cell death through ferroptosis.

off_label.title: Effect of Olanzapine on Opioid Craving and Misuse Among Patients Receiving Opioids for Cancer-related Pain: A Pilot Double-Blind, Randomized Control Trial
off_label.summary: Olanzapine may reduce opioid craving and misuse in cancer patients taking long-term pain medications.

off_label.title: Double Blind, Randomised, Placebo-controlled Study of Propranolol in Infantile Capillary Hemangiomas
off_label.summary: Propranolol, a common blood pressure medication, effectively slows growth of facial hemangiomas in infants under four months old.

off_label.title: Standardized workflow enables reproducibility of drug synergism detection: Results from a multi-center in vitro ring test on complex drug combinations in pancreatic cancer models.
off_label.summary: Standardized procedures across labs confirmed that combining valproic acid and simvastatin enhances pancreatic cancer cell death, improving reproducibility in drug synergy studies.

off_label.title: Non-enzymatic RNA Glycation is a Metabolic Sensor of Cellular Stress
off_label.summary: RNA glycation from metabolic stress impairs protein production and insulin secretion in pancreatic cells, but metformin reverses this effect.

off_label.title: Unveiling Remyelinating Properties of Roflumilast in CPZ-Induced Neuronal Demyelination in Mice.
off_label.summary: Roflumilast, a PDE-4 inhibitor, promotes remyelination and reduces inflammation in a mouse multiple sclerosis model.

off_label.title: Bevacizumab for Radiation-Induced (Radiculo)plexopathy.
off_label.summary: Bevacizumab shows promise as the first potential treatment for nerve damage that develops years after cancer radiation therapy.

off_label.title: Multi-omics reveals a novel Cxcr4+ subpopulation of alveolar macrophages and therapeutic effect of AMD3100 in mice with advanced silicosis.
off_label.summary: AMD3100 treatment reduces lung fibrosis in silicosis by targeting a specific immune cell population, offering a potential therapy for this occupational disease.

off_label.title: Potential Benefit of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2-Inhibitors in Cisplatin-Associated Nephrotoxicity Among Patients With Cancer Having Diabetes Mellitus.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may protect kidneys from cisplatin damage in cancer patients with diabetes by reducing drug uptake in kidney cells.

off_label.title: The GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Liraglutide Promotes Anticancer Activities in MCF7 Breast and PC-3 Prostate Cancer Cells by Modulating Glycolysis, Oxidative Stress and Adipokines.
off_label.summary: Liraglutide, a diabetes drug, kills breast and prostate cancer cells by increasing oxidative stress and triggering cell death pathways.

biomarkers.title: Early-stage drug discovery in a new-generation ultrahigh-throughput mass spectrometry platform.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists developed an automated mass spectrometry platform that accelerates drug discovery by synthesizing and testing drug candidates in a single, streamlined process.

biomarkers.title: Lung cancer therapy using a chitosan-based nano drug discovery system of silver nanoparticles and chemotherapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed chitosan nanoparticles combined with silver and chemotherapy drugs to more effectively treat lung cancer.

biomarkers.title: Multi-omics and artificial intelligence for precision drug discovery and potential clinical applications.
biomarkers.summary: AI combined with multi-omics data accelerates drug discovery by identifying disease patterns and predicting therapeutic targets more precisely across cancer and other diseases.

biomarkers.title: Super self-on biosensor based on target molecule-responsive mode and antifouling biopeptides for ultrasensitive detection of prostate specific antigen.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed an ultrasensitive biosensor for detecting prostate cancer markers in blood using a novel self-activating technology.

biomarkers.title: GOT1 promotes endometrial cancer progression by regulating ferroptosis through the STAT3-GPX4 axis and attenuating medroxyprogesterone acetate sensitivity.
biomarkers.summary: GOT1 protein promotes endometrial cancer growth and drug resistance by blocking ferroptosis through a STAT3-GPX4 pathway.

biomarkers.title: Deep learning prediction of pathological complete response in breast cancer using Mamba architecture.
biomarkers.summary: A new AI model predicts which breast cancer patients will respond well to chemotherapy before treatment begins.

biomarkers.title: ZIF-8/polydopamine nanocomposite functionalized with hyaluronic acid and folic acid for pH-responsive resveratrol delivery and apoptosis induction in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A nanoparticle delivery system successfully released resveratrol into colorectal cancer cells, triggering apoptosis and reducing cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

biomarkers.title: Machine learning-based identification of high-risk triple-negative breast cancer patients despite pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Machine learning identifies high-risk triple-negative breast cancer patients who achieve complete response but still face worse survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in germline BRCA-mutated early triple-negative breast cancer: a multicenter real-world cohort.
biomarkers.summary: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy before surgery achieves higher complete tumor elimination in triple-negative breast cancer patients with BRCA mutations.

biomarkers.title: Sphingosine kinase-2 inhibition promotes immunogenic differentiation of myeloid-derived suppressor cells through an Acetyl-CoA carboxylase-phosphatidylcholine axis.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking sphingosine kinase-2 reduces immune-suppressing cells and boosts immunotherapy response in breast, bladder, and melanoma cancers.

biomarkers.title: Targeting USP10/SCD1 axis by RAF265 suppresses lipogenesis and induced ferroptosis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: RAF265 suppresses head and neck cancer growth by blocking USP10, reducing fat production and triggering cancer cell death.

biomarkers.title: Surface cues shape procoagulant properties of amyloidogenic microclots.
biomarkers.summary: Abnormal protein-coated microclots resistant to normal breakdown drive dangerous blood clotting in inflammatory diseases.

biomarkers.title: The emerging role of disulfidptosis in metabolic synergistic death and cancer immunotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Disulfidptosis, a new cell death mechanism triggered by glucose deprivation, offers a novel approach to kill cancer cells and enhance immunotherapy across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Targeting Pyruvate Kinase M2: Signal Transduction Pathways and Exploration of Cancer Therapeutic Strategies.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking pyruvate kinase M2 shows promise as a cancer treatment by disrupting key tumor-promoting pathways, though clinical application remains challenging.

biomarkers.title: Cholesterol-depleting nanozyme amplifies membrane-diffusive ferroptosis for potentiating anti-tumor immunity in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a nanoparticle that depletes cholesterol in colorectal cancer cells, triggering cell death and boosting immune response against tumors.

trials.title: Effectiveness Comparisons of Various Psychological Therapies for Fear of Cancer Recurrence in Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: Psychological therapies effectively reduce cancer patients' fear of recurrence, with varying effectiveness levels across different treatment approaches.

trials.title: Comparative Efficacy of Non-Pharmacological Interventions on Fatigue, Depression, and Quality of Life in Patients With Lung Cancer: A Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
trials.summary: Exercise and psychological therapies effectively reduce fatigue and depression while improving quality of life in lung cancer patients.

trials.title: The moderating and mediating effects of mindful compassion with body-mind-spirit therapy using a blended approach of face-to-face with online for breast cancer patients' depression during COVID-19: A randomized controlled trial.
trials.summary: Combining mindfulness and compassion therapy with body-mind-spirit exercises reduces depression in breast cancer patients when delivered both in-person and online.

trials.title: Association between working alliance and treatment outcomes in a mobile health intervention with a conversational agent (CanRelax).
trials.summary: A mobile app with a conversational agent helped cancer patients reduce distress, with stronger user-agent relationships predicting better outcomes.

trials.title: Optimal yoga dose for improving cancer-related fatigue, quality of life, and sleep quality in breast cancer survivors: a Bayesian dose-response meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Yoga at optimal doses significantly improves fatigue, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in breast cancer survivors.

trials.title: Real-world integrative oncology in patients with cancer and diabetes: engagement patterns, outcomes.
trials.summary: Integrative oncology programs improved quality of life outcomes for cancer patients who also have diabetes.

trials.title: Lung cancer therapy using a chitosan-based nano drug discovery system of silver nanoparticles and chemotherapeutics.
trials.summary: Researchers developed chitosan nanoparticles combined with silver and chemotherapy drugs to more effectively treat lung cancer.

trials.title: Multi-omics and artificial intelligence for precision drug discovery and potential clinical applications.
trials.summary: AI combined with multi-omics data accelerates drug discovery by identifying disease patterns and predicting therapeutic targets more precisely across cancer and other diseases.

trials.title: Deep learning prediction of pathological complete response in breast cancer using Mamba architecture.
trials.summary: A new AI model predicts which breast cancer patients will respond well to chemotherapy before treatment begins.

trials.title: Machine learning-based identification of high-risk triple-negative breast cancer patients despite pathological complete response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Machine learning identifies high-risk triple-negative breast cancer patients who achieve complete response but still face worse survival outcomes.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy in germline BRCA-mutated early triple-negative breast cancer: a multicenter real-world cohort.
trials.summary: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy before surgery achieves higher complete tumor elimination in triple-negative breast cancer patients with BRCA mutations.

trials.title: Sphingosine kinase-2 inhibition promotes immunogenic differentiation of myeloid-derived suppressor cells through an Acetyl-CoA carboxylase-phosphatidylcholine axis.
trials.summary: Blocking sphingosine kinase-2 reduces immune-suppressing cells and boosts immunotherapy response in breast, bladder, and melanoma cancers.

trials.title: Immunomodulatory Hydrogel Coupling Pyroptosis Amplification With T-Cell Modulation to Block Postoperative Tumor Recurrence.
trials.summary: A surgical implant triggers cancer cell death and boosts immune cells to prevent tumor recurrence after surgery.

trials.title: Global burden of enteric infectious diseases, diarrhoeal diseases, and corresponding aetiologies, 1990-2023: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023.
trials.summary: Enteric infectious diseases claim more than 1 million lives annually and are among the top ten causes of death in children younger than 5 years.

trials.title: Impact of adjuvant breast radiotherapy on the risk and the survival of second primary lung cancer: a large population-based study.
trials.summary: Breast cancer patients who receive radiation therapy face increased lung cancer risk and need longer screening periods.
